title: Goa vs Kerala: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Goa for beaches, parties, and easy India travel. Kerala for backwaters, nature, food, and soul. Do both with 12+ days.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Goa wins on infrastructure and social scene. Kerala's Varkala and Kovalam are beautiful but less developed.

categories.name: Food & Cuisine
categories.summary: Kerala wins on depth — Sadya feast, appam, Kerala fish curry. Goa wins on atmosphere (beach shack + cold beer).

categories.name: Nature & Outdoors
categories.summary: Kerala's backwaters, Munnar, Periyar tiger reserve, and Western Ghats UNESCO zone dwarf Goa's nature.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Goa has Asia-class nightlife (Curlies, Shiva Valley). Kerala has virtually none.

categories.name: Ayurveda & Wellness
categories.summary: Kerala is the world capital of Ayurveda. Goa has basic massage parlors.

categories.name: Ease of Navigation
categories.summary: Goa's scooter culture makes it the easiest state in India to explore independently.

faq.question: Is Goa or Kerala better for a first visit to India?
faq.answer: Goa for first-timers who want easy beach access; Kerala for those who want depth and nature.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Goa or Kerala?
faq.answer: Goa is cheaper — ₹1,500–2,500/day vs ₹2,500–5,000/day in Kerala.

faq.question: What is the backwater houseboat experience like?
faq.answer: A converted rice barge glides through palm-fringed canals with meals and crew. ₹5,000–15,000/night. Non-negotiable Kerala.
